    78	/// Create a new app instance. This returns a stable pointer to the app
    79	/// instance which is required for callbacks.
    80	pub fn create(alloc: Allocator) CreateError!*App {
    81	    var app = try alloc.create(App);
    82	    errdefer alloc.destroy(app);
    83	    try app.init(alloc);
    84	
    85	    // If font discovery supports warmup, then we call it. Some font
    86	    // mechanisms (e.g. CoreText) have a multi-millisecond one-time cost
    87	    // on startup.
    88	    if (comptime @hasDecl(font.Discover, "warmup")) {
    89	        if (std.Thread.spawn(
    90	            .{},
    91	            font.Discover.warmup,
    92	            .{},
    93	        )) |thr| thr.detach() else |err| {
    94	            log.warn("font warmup thread spawn failed err={}", .{err});
    95	        }
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    // Same for the renderer's graphics API (e.g. Metal), which pays
    99	    // one-time framework initialization costs on first use.
   100	    if (comptime @hasDecl(renderer.Device, "warmup")) {
   101	        if (std.Thread.spawn(
   102	            .{},
   103	            renderer.Device.warmup,
   104	            .{},
   105	        )) |thr| thr.detach() else |err| {
   106	            log.warn("renderer warmup thread spawn failed err={}", .{err});
   107	        }
   108	    }
   109	
   110	    return app;
   111	}

   220	/// Delete the surface from the known surface list. This will NOT call the
   221	/// destructor or free the memory.
   222	pub fn deleteSurface(self: *App, rt_surface: *apprt.Surface) void {
   223	    // If this surface is the focused surface then we need to clear it.
   224	    // There was a bug where we relied on hasSurface to return false and
   225	    // just let focused surface be but the allocator was reusing addresses
   226	    // after free and giving false positives, so we must clear it.
   227	    if (self.focused_surface) |focused| {
   228	        if (focused == rt_surface.core()) {
   229	            self.focused_surface = null;
   230	        }
   231	    }
   232	
   233	    var i: usize = 0;
   234	    while (i < self.surfaces.items.len) {
   235	        if (self.surfaces.items[i] == rt_surface) {
   236	            _ = self.surfaces.swapRemove(i);
   237	            continue;
   238	        }
   239	
   240	        i += 1;
   241	    }
   242	
   243	    // If we have no surfaces, we can start the quit timer. It is up to the
   244	    // apprt to determine if this is necessary.
   245	    if (self.surfaces.items.len == 0) _ = rt_surface.rtApp().performAction(
   246	        .app,
   247	        .quit_timer,
   248	        .start,
   249	    ) catch |err| {
   250	        log.warn("error starting quit timer err={}", .{err});
   251	    };
   252	}

   272	/// Drain the mailbox.
   273	fn drainMailbox(self: *App, rt_app: *apprt.App) !void {
   274	    while (self.mailbox.pop(global.io())) |message| {
   275	        if (comptime std.log.logEnabled(.debug, .app)) {
   276	            switch (message) {
   277	                // these tend to be way too verbose for normal debugging
   278	                else => log.debug("mailbox message={t}", .{message}),
   279	            }
   280	        }
   281	        switch (message) {
   282	            .open_config => |v| try self.performAction(
   283	                rt_app,
   284	                .{
   285	                    .open_config = switch (v) {
   286	                        .os_open => .os_open,
   287	                        .new_window => .new_window,
   288	                    },
   289	                },
   290	            ),
   291	            .new_window => |msg| try self.newWindow(rt_app, msg),
   292	            .close => |surface| self.closeSurface(surface),
   293	            .surface_message => |msg| try self.surfaceMessage(msg.surface, msg.message),
   294	
   295	            // If we're quitting, then we set the quit flag and stop
   296	            // draining the mailbox immediately. This lets us defer
   297	            // mailbox processing to the next tick so that the apprt
   298	            // can try to quit as quickly as possible.
   299	            .quit => {
   300	                log.info("quit message received, short circuiting mailbox drain", .{});
   301	                try self.performAction(rt_app, .quit);
   302	                return;
   303	            },
   304	        }
   305	    }
   306	}
